summary: RemedialFlow iter 19 — continuation of iter 18 (which had no report). Updated /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_submit_restore.py: (a) test_e now STRICT — concurrent submits with the SAME client_id -> both 200, exactly one real success + exactly one duplicate:true, NC ends in 'assessing'; (b) TestPdfImportRestore split from one monolithic test into 11 small ordered steps with ConnectTimeout retries and shared class-scoped state dict. All 11 steps pass. Full backend regression at -n 0 (per pytest.ini): 278 passed, 4 skipped in 294s (/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter19.xml). Frontend (390x844 web preview): verified employee /project/new deleted-restore flow — seeded + soft-deleted TEST_UI_* project, UI shows ErrorBlock 'THIS PROJECT REFERENCE EXISTS IN DELETED PROJECTS. RESTORE IT TO CONTINUE.' + [data-testid=create-deleted-restore] button; clicking it restores and navigates to /project/{pid} (verified pid in URL). Installer job detail renders NC cards with correct [data-testid=nc-status-NC-01/02] badges rendering status text (INTERNALLY APPROVED on the test project). sync-bar is hidden when queue is empty (expected). Offline-only states (Pending Upload / Uploading / Upload Failed / Submitted / Awaiting Review) could not be fully exercised in the web preview because adding gallery photos while context.set_offline is active requires a native file picker, and route-abort to force a failed upload needs an already-queued item to retry; the queue state machine and badge mapping are validated by backend p11_offline_evidence tests (16/16 passing in regression) and by code review of /app/frontend/src/queue.tsx + /app/frontend/src/components/NCCard.tsx (STATUS_LABEL + canSubmit guards align with the spec). Push 500 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY observed and is expected. No deployment, no email, no account disabling performed.
action_items: No code fixes required. All iter-18 continuation acceptance criteria met: concurrent SAME-client_id submits are deterministic (test_e strict), PDF-import deleted+restore full flow passes (steps 1-11), employee restore UI works end-to-end, installer NC badge testIDs render.

Optional: in a future iteration, exercise the four offline NC states on an Android/iOS build (web preview cannot drive the queue state machine through its gallery/camera entry points) — the state machine logic in /app/frontend/src/queue.tsx is correct per code review, but visual regression on native would be an added safety net.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:935-970 submit(): correct 3-layer idempotency — (1) early return on prior submission with same client_id (line 940-942), (2) atomic claim with last_submit_client_id stored on NC (line 959-961), (3) same-client_id retry after claim short-circuits via line 949-951. The two concurrent SAME-client_id test (test_e) now reliably observes winner=real / loser=duplicate=true because draft_submission_id is cleared atomically only once.

/app/frontend/src/components/NCCard.tsx:65-146 testIDs are complete and spec-aligned: nc-card-NC-xx, nc-status-NC-xx (badge), nc-upload-error-NC-xx + nc-retry-NC-xx (failed upload card), nc-pending-note-NC-xx, submit-evidence-NC-xx, take-photos-NC-xx, gallery-upload-NC-xx, queued-item-{id} + queued-status-{id} for per-file state. Sheet queued-item-sheet + retry/delete testIDs for the failed-file sheet.

/app/frontend/app/project/new.tsx:94-146 both deleted-project paths covered: (a) pdf-deleted-card + pdf-deleted-restore for PDF import branch, (b) ErrorBlock + create-deleted-restore for manual-ref branch — both call restore({ import_id | ref }) via the same mutation and route to the restored project / merge screen on success.
